office_name: County Judge + Sheriff + County Clerk + District Clerk + Tax Assessor-Collector + County Treasurer
notes: Six countywide elected offices share the Kerr County boundary. Current holders: County Judge Rob Kelly; Sheriff Larry L. Leitha Jr.; County Clerk Nadene Alford; District Clerk Eunavae Baublit Tonroy; Tax Assessor-Collector Bob Reeves; County Treasurer Tracy Soldan. The District Clerk is the one current holder who entered an elected office through joint judicial appointment after Dawn Lantz retired March 31, 2026; no duplicate office or holder is created from Tonroy’s 2026 candidacy.

Tom Jones is the current elected Commissioner for Precinct 1. The county-linked ArcGIS polygon layer uses precinct 1; all four features carry Court Order 39047, adopted November 3, 2021 and effective January 1, 2022.
